text.body: upadiṣṭo dharmaḥ prativedam || tasyānu |vyākhyāsyāmaḥ || smārto dvitīyaḥ || tṛtīyaḥ śiṣṭāgamaḥ || śiṣṭāḥ khalu vigatamatsarā nirahaṃkārāḥ kumbhīdhānyā alolupā dambhadarpalobhamohakrodhavivarjitāḥ || dharmeṇādhigato yeṣāṃ vedaḥ saparibṛṃhaṇaḥ | śiṣṭās tadanumānajñāḥ śrutipratyakṣahetavaḥ || iti || tadabhāve daśāvarā pariṣat || athāpyudāharanti | cāturvaidyaṃ vikalpī ca aṅgavid dharmapāṭhakaḥ | āśramasthās trayo viprāḥ parṣad eṣā daśāvarā || pañca vā |syus trayo vā |syur eko vā |syād aninditaḥ | prativaktā tu dharmasya netare tu sahasraśaḥ || yathā dārumayo hastī yathā carmamayo mṛgaḥ | brāhmaṇaś cānadhīyānas trayas te nāmadhārakāḥ || yad |vadanti tamomūḍhā mūrkhā dharmam ajānataḥ | tat pāpaṃ śatadhā |bhūtvā vaktṝn |samadhigacchati || bahudvārasya dharmasya sūkṣmā duranugā gatiḥ | tasmān na vācyo hy ekena bahujñenāpi saṃśaye || dharmaśāstrarathārūḍhā vedakhaḍgadharā dvijāḥ | krīḍārtham api yad |brūyuḥ sa dharmaḥ paramaḥ smṛtaḥ || yathāśmani sthitaṃ toyaṃ mārutārkau |praṇāśayet | tadvat kartari yat pāpaṃ jalavat |saṃpralīyate || śarīraṃ balam āyuś ca vayaḥ kālaṃ ca karma ca | samīkṣya dharmavid buddhyā prāyaścittāni |nirdiśet || avratānām amantrāṇāṃ jātimātropajīvinām | sahasraśaḥ sametānāṃ pariṣattvaṃ na |vidyate || iti || pañcadhā vipratipattir dakṣiṇatas tathottarataḥ || yāni dakṣiṇatas tāni |vyākhyāsyāmaḥ || yathaitad anupetena saha bhojanaṃ striyā saha bhojanaṃ paryuṣitabhojanaṃ mātulapitṛsvasṛduhitṛgamanam iti || athottarata ūrṇāvikrayaḥ sīdhupānam ubhayatodadbhir vyavahāra āyudhīyakaṃ samudrasaṃyānam iti || itarad itarasmin kurvan |duṣyatītarad itarasmin || tatra tatra deśaprāmāṇyam eva |syāt || mithyaitad iti gautamaḥ || ubhayaṃ caiva | nādriyeta śiṣṭasmṛtivirodhadarśanāt || prāg ādarśāt pratyak vidharaṇī sūryasyodayanaṃ puraḥ | yāvat kṛṣṇā |vidhāvanti tāvad dhi brahmavarcasam || iti || avantayo’ṅgamagadhāḥ surāṣṭrā dakṣiṇāpathāḥ | upāvṛtsindhusauvīrā ete saṃkīrṇayonayaḥ || āraṭṭān kāraskarān prayuñjānaḥ pāpebhyo |vipramucyate || pāpebhyo vipramucyata iti || <1.2> aṣṭācatvāriṃśad varṣāṇi paurāṇaṃ vedabrahmacaryam || caturviṃśatiṃ dvādaśa vā prativedam || saṃvatsarāvamaṃ vā pratikāṇḍam || grahaṇāntaṃ vā jīvitasyāsthiratvāt || kṛṣṇakeśo’gnīn |ādadhīteti śrutiḥ || nāsya karma |niyacchanti kiṃcid ā mauñjibandhanāt | vṛttyā śūdrasamo hy eṣa yāvad vedena jāyate || iti || garbhādiḥ saṃkhyā varṣāṇām | tadaṣṭameṣu brāhmaṇam |upanayīta || tryadhikeṣu rājanyam || tasmād ekādhikeṣu vaiśyam || vasanto grīṣmaḥ śarad ity ṛtavo varṇānupūrvyeṇa || gāyatrītriṣṭubjagatībhir yathākramam || ā ṣoḍaśād ā dvāviṃśād ā caturviṃśād anātyaya eṣāṃ krameṇa || mauñjī dhanurjyā śāṇīti mekhalāḥ || kṛṣṇarurubastājināny ajināni || mūrdhalalāṭanāsāgrapramāṇā yājñikasya vṛkṣasya daṇḍāḥ || bhavatpūrvāṃ bhikṣāmadhyāṃ yācñāntāṃ bhikṣāṃ |caret saptākṣarāṃ kṣāṃ ca hiṃ ca na |vardhayet || bhavatpūrvāṃ brāhmaṇo |bhikṣeta bhavanmadhyāṃ rājanyo bhavadantāṃ vaiśyaḥ sarveṣu varṇeṣu || te brāhmaṇādyāḥ svakarmasthāḥ || sadāraṇyāt samidha |āhṛtyādadhyāt || satyavādī hrīmān anahaṃkāraḥ || pūrvotthāyī jaghanyasaṃveśī || sarvatrāpratihataguruvākyo’nyatra pātakāt || yāvadarthasaṃbhāṣī strībhiḥ ||
